0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000010_HANCOCK
0.description: My friends! Thank you for coming at such short notice!

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000020_ALISAIE
1.description: We were told the matter was urgent. I take it Yugiri and Soroban are also involved?

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000030_SOROBAN
2.description: Ah, my presence here is but a happy coincidence. I am come on separate business─which can wait.

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000050_YUGIRI
4.description: Master Hancock─pray tell our friends exactly what you told me.

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000070_HANCOCK
6.description: Some few days ago, a large detachment of soldiers was seen arriving at the Garlean embassy. This seemed to me most unusual, as no personages of note are due to visit for a matter of months.

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000080_HANCOCK
7.description: So I made a few inquiries, whereupon I learned of a most curious rumor.

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000090_HANCOCK
8.description: Apparently, the soldiers were dispatched to Kugane to investigate recent sightings of a certain individual.

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000100_HANCOCK
9.description: The late acting imperial viceroy of Doma─Yotsuyu!

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000120_YUGIRI
11.description: I, too, am loath to believe it. I saw the keep come down on top of her.

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000140_HANCOCK
13.description: I would not presume to question your eyewitness accounts, nor am I one to take rumors at face value. The fact is, the Garleans have no knowledge of what took place at Doma Castle─they may well be chasing after a woman who merely resembles Yotsuyu.

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000150_HANCOCK
14.description: But a woman who resembles Yotsuyu in the company of a grizzled Roegadyn samurai? I daresay that thickens the plot.

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000170_HANCOCK
16.description: While I've no conclusive proof, I thought that such a possibility warranted your attention.

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000190_ALISAIE
18.description: Well, I think we'd all like to believe the old bear survived.

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000200_YUGIRI
19.description: Indeed. While I dare not give myself wholly to hope, I will not deny that I have prayed for such a miracle ever since that fateful day.

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000210_YUGIRI
20.description: But regardless of my personal feelings, if the Empire has seen fit to pursue these rumors so vigorously, we can scarce afford to ignore them.

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000220_YUGIRI
21.description: I am bound by duty to ascertain the truth of the matter. Will you join me in this quest?

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_A1_000_002_NONE_VOICE
24.description: I...am not sure what I'd do if I saw Yotsuyu again.

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000230_YUGIRI
25.description: Thank you. If Gosetsu yet lives, he will need our help if he is to avoid capture.

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000240_YUGIRI
26.description: I understand. Only too well. But if Gosetsu yet lives, he will need our help if he is to avoid capture.

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000250_ALPHINAUD
27.description: Gosetsu is a dear friend, and we cannot abandon him to the mercy of the Empire. Our course is clear.

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000260_ALPHINAUD
28.description: Hancock, is there aught else you can tell us?

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000270_HANCOCK
29.description: Alas not─but I have taken the liberty of employing one of the finest informants money can buy. You shall have the latest intelligence on the Garleans' movements and more besides.

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000280_ALPHINAUD
30.description: Right. I suggest we begin by learning what we can from the sentries.

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000300_IKARUGA
32.description: Travelers, are you? You may wish to postpone your plans. The Garleans have launched an attack on the Confederacy.

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000310_IKARUGA
33.description: We have no reason to believe they'll turn their attention here, but for your own safety I suggest you return to Kugane.

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000320_YUGIRI
34.description: The Garleans bear no love for the Confederacy, but with Doma lost to them, why would they attack? Unless...

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000330_ALPHINAUD
35.description: Unless Yotsuyu is on that island.

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000340_ALISAIE
36.description: Even if she isn't, our allies are under attack, and they need our help.

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000350_ALPHINAUD
37.description: <hex:021A020203>We<hex:021A020103> will help them, while <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103> remain with Soroban. Arguing will only delay us. Is that clear?

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000360_ALISAIE
38.description: Fine. But you haven't heard the last of this.

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000370_ALPHINAUD
39.description: Soroban─we may need to make a swift exit. See that the boat is ready to sail at a moment's notice.

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000390_ALISAIE
41.description: What, and you're going to <hex:021A020203>swim<hex:021A020103> there, are you?

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000400_ALPHINAUD
42.description: 'Tis the quickest way. And you may rest assured I've been practicing!

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000430_IMPERIALCENTURION
45.description: Lady Yotsuyu, we're here to rescue you! Please come with us!

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000490_IMPERIALCENTURION
51.description: Damn it! We took too long. Change of plan─eliminate hostiles!

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000510_GOSETSU
54.description: Yugiri, my friends... The kami were kind to guide your steps this way.

55.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000520_TANSUI
55.description: It's over. The imperials are retreating. I suppose we have you to thank for that.

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000530_TANSUI
56.description: But they would never have come here were it not for <hex:021A020203>her<hex:021A020103>. I had a bad feeling the moment your samurai friend arrived with that woman in tow.

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000540_GOSETSU
57.description: Do not be afraid, Tsuyu. These people are my friends.

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000560_ALPHINAUD
59.description: Forgive me, but at the risk of souring the mood, I believe you owe us an explanation. You may start by telling us what happened at Doma Castle.

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000570_GOSETSU
60.description: Of course. I'll not begrudge you that. As you know, we were trapped inside the keep when it collapsed. But even as the roof crumbled above us, so too did the floor below.

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000580_GOSETSU
61.description: We were swept out into the One River, where we would surely have drowned had a stout wooden door not chanced to float by, offering us a raft of sorts.

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000590_GOSETSU
62.description: Exhausted, we drifted out to sea, at the mercy of the tides...which saw fit to dispense us on a desert island.

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000600_ALPHINAUD
63.description: She was with you the entire time?

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000610_GOSETSU
64.description: Aye. 'Twas her kimono which saved her from Hien's blade, believe it or not. Some Garlean witchcraft in the weave.

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000620_GOSETSU
65.description: But it offered precious little protection against the fall. Though she survived, she awoke bereft of all her memories, and speaking like a child.

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000640_GOSETSU
67.description: That was my first thought, aye. And I contemplated cutting her down and being done with it. Contemplated it long and hard...

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000650_GOSETSU
68.description: Yet the kami saw fit to deliver us from certain death. 'Twas their will that we survive. Both of us. Together. And together we shall go before our master. He shall be the one to judge.

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000670_TANSUI
70.description: She's your prisoner, old man. Do with her as you will. Call her “Tsuyu” or whatever else tickles your fancy.

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000680_GOSETSU
71.description: 'Twas a name given out of necessity whilst on the road. Nothing more.

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000700_TANSUI
73.description: But remember this: our people suffered much at that woman's hands. When the time comes, I trust you won't let emotion blind you to what needs to be done.

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000720_TANSUI
75.description: Well, I must be going─I've an unholy mess to clean up. You should be on your way too, before the imperials decide to take another tilt. Oh...and we'll overlook the tithe this once. You're welcome.

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000730_GOSETSU
76.description: My lord Hien. I am returned.

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000740_HIEN
77.description: Save your tears for the morrow. For we who yet walk the path should not think too much on the destination.

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000750_HIEN
78.description: When the hour arrives, we shall welcome what comes with open arms.

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000760_HIEN
79.description: And welcome it you did, even as the keep fell down around us. At that moment, in your smile, I spied a shred of hope. One which I have clung to ever since.

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000770_HIEN
80.description: Gosetsu. Full glad am I to see you alive and well.

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000780_GOSETSU
81.description: We have played this scene before, have we not? Though this time our roles are reversed.

83.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000800_HIEN
83.description: Meaning you know how I feel.

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000801_HIEN
84.description: Wholly at a loss for words. Welcome back, old friend!

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000810_HIEN
85.description: Now then, though we rejoice at your return, it seems you have brought with you certain...complications.

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000820_HIEN
86.description: Rise, my friend. Tell me everything.

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000830_HIEN
87.description: The Empire is bold indeed to send a token force to engage the Confederacy.

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000840_YUGIRI
88.description: As acting viceroy, Yotsuyu would have been privy to imperial secrets. The Garleans will not soon give up the chase.

89.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000850_HIEN
89.description: Nay. It will end with her capture...or her death.

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000870_GOSETSU
91.description: She claims to have lost her memory, though I know not if she speaks true. I brought her here that you might decide her fate.

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000890_HIEN
93.description: Regardless, the people have not forgotten. Her face yet haunts their dreams. She cannot roam free. We will hold her here for a time.

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000900_HIEN
94.description: Place her in Jifuya's care, with the express instruction that she is not to be seen.

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000940_YOTSUYU
98.description: Don't let her take me away!

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000950_GOSETSU
99.description: It's all right, Tsuyu. I will come with you. Be a good girl and listen to Yugiri.

100.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000960_HIEN
100.description: From a hound at his throat to a puppy at his heel...

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000961_HIEN
101.description: If this is an act, it is a remarkable performance.

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000970_JIFUYA
102.description: By the kami! You're Lord Hien's─ L-Leave me! Leave me, I beg of you! Say nothing of this! I was never here!

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_000990_JIFUYA
104.description: Lady Yugiri. Lord Gosetsu. Forgive me my abrupt disappearance.

105.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001000_GOSETSU
105.description: You have your reasons, I am sure. Will you not share them?

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001010_JIFUYA
106.description: I was...I was her master. When she was yet a courtesan.

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001040_JIFUYA
109.description: Her father was a regular client of mine. One day, quite without preamble, he offered to sell her to me. “She may be no maiden,” he said, “but she has some use left in her.”

110.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001050_JIFUYA
110.description: He sold her short. When I first beheld her, I was struck by her beauty. And yet, behind her eyes, there was...an emptiness. 'Twas as if she had given up on life. She seemed more a doll than a woman.

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001060_JIFUYA
111.description: It was no profession for her, but I knew she would be popular. And so it proved. Men flocked to drown themselves in that cold, bottomless gaze.

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001070_JIFUYA
112.description: The rest you know. She became an imperial informant, and for her loyal service won the office of acting viceroy.

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001080_GOSETSU
113.description: ...While you came to serve the Liberation Front.

114.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001090_JIFUYA
114.description: 'Tis said that the atrocities Yotsuyu committed were driven by vengeance. If so, I bear part of the blame for creating the monster she became.

115.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001100_JIFUYA
115.description: Joining the Front was meant to be my atonement.

116.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001110_JIFUYA
116.description: But the truth is... The truth is, I am a coward whose only thought was to escape her wrath. Then as now.

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001120_GOSETSU
117.description: ...I see. Then I shall recommend that you be assigned to a new post.

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001130_GOSETSU
118.description: I trust you have no objections, Yugiri?

119.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001140_YUGIRI
119.description: None. It would not do to leave Yotsuyu in his care.

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001160_YUGIRI
121.description: Who is it that you seek to protect, Gosetsu?

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001170_YUGIRI
122.description: Idle musings. Pray pay me no mind.

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001190_YUGIRI
124.description: In former times, such signals were used to announce the coming of an emissary of peace─in Doma, at least. But could that truly be their intent?

126.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001210_HIEN
126.description: Whatever they want, we cannot simply blast them out of the sky─not when they were so gracious as to honor one of our <hex:021A020203>cherished<hex:021A020103> traditions. I would not have it said that we Domans want for propriety.

127.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001220_YUGIRI
127.description: Then I shall go and reconnoiter.

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001230_HIEN
128.description: Nay, that won't be necessary. We will meet them openly.

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001240_HIEN
129.description: I would welcome this student of Doman history in person, whomsoever he or she may be...

130.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001250_YUGIRI
130.description: As you wish, my lord. I shall arrange for a signal of our own to be fired in answer.

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001260_ASAHI
131.description: Well! That we should be received by the lord of Doma himself!

132.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001270_HIEN
132.description: I but afford an emissary of peace the courtesy he is due.

134.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001280_ASAHI
134.description: Ah, where are my manners? I am Asahi sas Brutus, ambassador plenipotentiary of Garlemald.

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001290_YUGIRI
135.description: He is heir to the Naeuri clan...and Yotsuyu's stepbrother.

136.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001300_ASAHI
136.description: It seems I need not introduce myself─not in the presence of the famed Yugiri Mistwalker. Your skills as a shinobi are known far and wide, my lady.

137.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001310_ASAHI
137.description: It is true─the former acting viceroy is my sister. Yet, bonds of kinship aside, we have precious little in common. As will soon become plain, I come not to sow strife, but to end it.

138.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001320_ASAHI
138.description: I am of the Populares, a collective which represents the interests of the common man. Long have we labored to bring about reform to the Empire's provincial policy.

139.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001330_ASAHI
139.description: Happily for us, our master acknowledges the need for change. Indeed, His Radiance, Emperor Varis zos Galvus personally sanctioned this mission, granting me the authority to speak with his voice.

141.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001340_HIEN
141.description: Well then, we have much to discuss.

142.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001350_HIEN
142.description: Will you accompany me to my hall?

144.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001370_ASAHI
144.description: On behalf of my delegation, I offer you my humblest thanks. Never did I imagine that I would meet the gallant and noble lord of Doma himself, nor be welcomed into his magnificent hall.

145.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001380_HIEN
145.description: You'll forgive me if we forgo the pleasantries. You say you are come to negotiate peace.

146.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001390_HIEN
146.description: Unless I am mistaken, such negotiations are typically conducted between <hex:021A020203>sovereign<hex:021A020103> nations. I was not aware that the Emperor had recognized Doma's sovereignty.

147.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001400_ASAHI
147.description: His Radiance has yet to do so, that much is true. Know, however, that he has expressed willingness to cede Doma to her ancestral masters and treat with her as a friend.

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001410_ASAHI
148.description: Since the days of Emperor Solus, the Empire has aggressively expanded its territory.

149.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001420_ASAHI
149.description: While you may not agree with our founding father's policy of expansion, I believe there is room for discussion on the matter of his lifelong goal─to rid the world of eikons.

150.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001430_ASAHI
150.description: Eikons are a blight upon this star. They cannot be suffered to exist. This you know as well as we. In his wisdom, Emperor Varis wishes to explore the possibility of an alliance to combat this common threat.

151.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001440_ASAHI
151.description: On the condition that Doma renounces summoning and pledges to police the Kojin's practice of it, His Radiance would extend the hand of friendship.

152.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001450_HIEN
152.description: Doma has never shown any appetite for summoning. And it should go without saying that we will address any threat to our people, eikon or otherwise.

153.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001460_HIEN
153.description: With regard to the Kojin, I must stress that they only resorted to summoning under extreme provocation. When the Ruby Sea was at peace, and their sacred relics safe, they looked not to their kami for protection.

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001470_HIEN
154.description: Yet even now there are certain parties who would destabilize the region with ill-conceived military forays. Unless they alter their course, we cannot hope to be rid of eikons.

156.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001490_ASAHI
156.description: In seeking to eliminate eikons, the Empire creates them. 'Tis an irony among ironies. One with which the people of Eorzea are well acquainted, I am told.

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001500_ALPHINAUD
157.description: Indeed, many summonings are the result of persecution, the weak being driven to call upon the divine for deliverance from the strong. So it was in Ala Mhigo─the bitter fruit of Garlean oppression.

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001510_ASAHI
158.description: A tragic state of affairs. If we are to put an end to summoning once and for all, it shall not be through might, but harmony. Yet we continue to repeat our mistakes, oblivious to the lessons of history.

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001520_ASAHI
159.description: My comrades and I would change all that. We Populares have campaigned long and hard for a shift in imperial policy, and at last the Emperor has seen fit to lend us an ear.

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001530_ASAHI
160.description: Alas, there is a faction within Garlemald that would obstruct our every attempt at reform. A collection of pure-blooded Garleans who seek to consolidate their own supremacy: the Optimates.

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001540_ASAHI
161.description: Lest you wonder, theirs was the hand that loosed our forces on the Confederacy. 'Twas a regrettable incident, one that flies in the face of everything we believe, and I swear to do all in my power to prevent a reoccurrence.

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001550_HIEN
162.description: That would be most welcome. But if I may speak plain─if the Empire itself is not of one mind, how can we be certain that any peace we negotiate will be honored?

163.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001560_ASAHI
163.description: I cannot blame you for doubting us. Indeed, I should find it strange if you did not. And so, in the name of building trust, I would like to make a proposal: a prisoner exchange.

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001580_ASAHI
165.description: Under Garlean rule, no few Domans were conscripted into the imperial army. We would repatriate them in return for those of ours you captured in the recent conflict.

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001590_ASAHI
166.description: Naturally, any exchange would include the acting viceroy.

167.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001600_HIEN
167.description: Yotsuyu? What makes you think we have her?

168.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001610_ASAHI
168.description: Forgive me, my lord. Was it not your wish to speak plain? Let us not play games. I desire only to work to our mutual benefit.

169.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001620_ASAHI
169.description: The Optimates tried─and failed─to take my sister by force. I would succeed by peaceable means, thereby strengthening my party's hand. 'Twould be a lie to say I would not also be glad of my sister's safe return.

170.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001630_HIEN
170.description: A fellow plain-speaker. How refreshing. Very well. Your proposal has merit, but I will need time to consider it.

171.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001640_ASAHI
171.description: Of course, my lord. May we remain in Doma until you have come to a decision?

172.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001650_HIEN
172.description: You shall be our honored guests.

173.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001660_HIEN
173.description: Yugiri, I leave the ambassador and his retinue in your care. See that they are well looked after.

174.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001670_ASAHI
174.description: You have our gratitude, Lord Hien. We shall look forward to your answer.

179.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001720_YUGIRI
179.description: What do they want with you?

180.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001730_ISSE
180.description: Yugiri!? And you lot, too!? I─

181.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001740_ISSE
181.description: I don't know. We were returning from the enclave when they came at us.

182.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001750_ALISAIE
182.description: It seems they won't go quietly.

184.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001770_ASAHI
184.description: That seems to be the last of them.

185.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001780_ASAHI
185.description: You have nothing to fear, child. You are safe now.

187.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001800_ISSE
187.description: You saved us again. Thank you. If you're ever passing by our village, look us up. You'll always be welcome.

188.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001810_ASAHI
188.description: Thank goodness we arrived when we did.

189.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001820_ALISAIE
189.description: Indeed. But what could have prompted the Red Kojin to stray so far from the Ruby Sea?

190.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001830_ASAHI
190.description: I presume these are the sellswords hired by Yotsuyu?

191.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001840_ASAHI
191.description: If so, the answer is simple: desperation. Bereft of imperial employment, they seek other means to line their coinpurses. Another sad legacy of the Empire's mismanagement.

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001850_YUGIRI
192.description: The Empire to which you have sworn allegiance.

193.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001860_ASAHI
193.description: Must you always be so pointed? If we are to bring about lasting change, we must look beyond narrow allegiances.

194.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001870_ASAHI
194.description: You have every right to doubt me, but in time I hope you will come to see that we share a common goal.

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001880_ASAHI
195.description: You and yours have fought fiercely to change the Empire from without, but if we are to end the cycle of conflict, the Empire must change from within. Am I wrong?

197.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_A2_000_001_NONE_VOICE
197.description: Not about that. True reform can only come from within.

199.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001890_ASAHI
199.description: I knew you would understand. You have witnessed such change firsthand, after all, during your time in Ishgard.

200.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001900_ASAHI
200.description: Never? I wonder, would you have said the same of Ishgard? ...Believe what you will, but I assure you: the Empire <hex:021A020203>can<hex:021A020103> change.

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001910_HIEN
201.description: I had her brought here in secret while the three of you kept our guest company.

202.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001920_HIEN
202.description: The world has not been kind to you, it is true. But that does not excuse your sins. You should be at the bottom of the river.

203.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001930_HIEN
203.description: Yet here you are, the living, breathing proof of my failure. A failure for which I would now make amends.

204.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001940_YOTSUYU
204.description: What did I do? I don't remember.

205.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001950_YOTSUYU
205.description: Was it really so terrible? Tell me, please! What did I do!?

206.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001960_GOSETSU
206.description: You speak of sins, my lord, but at whose feet do those sins lie?

207.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001970_GOSETSU
207.description: With the soldiers who committed the crimes, or those who commanded them to do so?

208.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001980_GOSETSU
208.description: With both, I would say, for all have a conscience, and all must choose. But with no memory of who she is or what she has done, what sin remains to be cleansed?

209.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_001990_HIEN
209.description: You ask that I show mercy?

210.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002000_GOSETSU
210.description: I ask why the heavens saw fit to deny me my rest.

211.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002010_GOSETSU
211.description: Why Yotsuyu was spared not only death but the bitter memories of her life.

212.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002020_HIEN
212.description: You truly think it the will of the kami...

213.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002030_HIEN
213.description: If so, her life is not mine to take. It is yours to safeguard.

214.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002040_HIEN
214.description: Come the hour of the exchange, if her memories have not returned, she may remain here in Doma to live out her days as Tsuyu.

215.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002050_HIEN
215.description: But if they do, the Garleans shall have their viceroy. Though the people will protest, they will come to accept my decision when they have been reunited with their loved ones.

217.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002070_HIEN
217.description: Now, then. I believe we have kept our guest waiting long enough.

218.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002080_HIEN
218.description: Did Gosetsu not seem strange to you?

219.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002081_HIEN
219.description: His sympathy for Yotsuyu apart, I mean.

220.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002090_HIEN
220.description: I know his powers of endurance only too well, but after all he has suffered, even he should not be on his feet.

221.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002100_HIEN
221.description: He puts on a brave face for our sakes, but it would not surprise me if he lacked the strength to raise his blade.

222.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002110_HIEN
222.description: ...Though I suppose if he and Yotsuyu are to enjoy a life of peace and quiet, he will have little use for it.

223.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002120_HIEN
223.description: It falls to us to shape that future. One in which he need never again set foot on the battlefield.

224.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002130_HIEN
224.description: My apologies. Our deliberations took longer than expected.

225.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002140_ASAHI
225.description: Think nothing of it. The time afforded me the opportunity to go on a rather rousing excursion through Yanxia.

226.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002150_ASAHI
226.description: You have reached a decision, then?

227.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002160_HIEN
227.description: We are willing to cooperate with you in combating the eikon threat, and also in the exchange of prisoners. Assuming you accept our conditions, of course.

228.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002170_HIEN
228.description: As you know, your sister is in our care. Due to certain complications, however, we are hesitant to release her into your custody.

230.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002190_HIEN
230.description: She was inside Doma Castle when it collapsed. Though she survived, she remembers nothing of her past life─not even her name.

231.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002200_HIEN
231.description: To clarify, she is in our care not as a prisoner, but as a vulnerable citizen of Doma.

232.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002210_ASAHI
232.description: Are you saying you refuse to release her?

233.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002220_HIEN
233.description: Not at all. If her memory returns before the appointed hour.

234.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002230_ASAHI
234.description: And if not, what exactly...? You will accommodate her here in Doma?

235.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002240_HIEN
235.description: Well, I sincerely doubt she will be of any great strategic value to the Empire. She spends her days daydreaming of dango.

238.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002260_ASAHI
238.description: Very well. In light of our recent...misstep in Sakazuki, it seems only fair that I show you the same understanding you have shown us.

239.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002270_ASAHI
239.description: ...Though I do have one, small request. Regardless of Yotsuyu's value to the Empire, she is yet my sister. Before I leave, might you permit me to speak with her in private?

240.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002280_HIEN
240.description: Of course. Perhaps you could even bring her a plate of dango. She would be most pleased.

241.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002290_HIEN
241.description: Yugiri will see you to her chambers.

242.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002300_HIEN
242.description: I wish you a safe journey.

243.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002310_ASAHI
243.description: This has been a most enjoyable visit. I look forward to our next meeting.

244.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002320_ASAHI
244.description: Maxima, would you take the others and see that all is ready for our departure?

245.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002330_ASAHI
245.description: I simply cannot leave without first giving thanks to the Warrior of Light for accompanying me through Yanxia.

246.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002340_ASAHI
246.description: Mark me, savior of the savages. There will be a reckoning.

247.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002350_RESISTANCE
247.description: You've nowhere left to run, traitor!

248.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002360_ASAHI
248.description: Ignorant savages. Killing us will avail you naught.

249.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002370_ASAHI
249.description: For every imperial you cut down, a thousand more will come. Abandon this foolish endeavor and surrender. You may yet serve our righteous cause.

250.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002380_RESISTANCE
250.description: How dare you speak of righteousness! You who forsook kith and kin to serve conquerors!

251.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002390_RESISTANCE
251.description: Be glad I grant you this mercy.

257.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002450_ZENOS
257.description: Who remains to offer us resistance?

258.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002460_ASAHI
258.description: A...a host of rebels led by Lord Kaien hold the enclave across the river.

260.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002480_ASAHI
260.description: The king of─th-the <hex:021A020203>former<hex:021A020103> king of Doma, sir. They say he is one of the greatest swordsmen alive.

263.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002510_WOUNDEDIMPERIAL
263.description: Surely you jest? That was Zenos yae Galvus, legatus of the XIIth─the crown bloody prince! I'd heard he was strong, but that...that was frightening.

265.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002530_ASAHI
265.description: Everything you are─your power, even your face─it vexes me.

266.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002540_ASAHI
266.description: Go on. Lash out like the beast you are. At an emissary. And jeopardize the newfound peace between Doma and the Empire.

267.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002550_ASAHI
267.description: My lord was destined to lead us unto a glorious new age. Your light is nothing to his radiance.

268.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002551_ASAHI
268.description: I will cherish this moment─lock it away within my heart─until the day we meet again.

269.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002560_HIEN
269.description: You look troubled, my friend. Was it something he said?

270.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002570_ALISAIE
270.description: Of all the memories to witness.

271.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002580_YUGIRI
271.description: I had my doubts about him, but I would never have guessed he was a disciple of Zenos.

273.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002600_HIEN
273.description: Calm yourself, Yugiri. I set no store by him or his enlightened brethren.

274.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002610_HIEN
274.description: But if by treating with them there is even the faintest hope we might secure the return of our conscripted brothers and sisters, I must play this game.

275.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002620_HIEN
275.description: After the way I risked their lives in the rebellion, I owe them that much.

276.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002630_YUGIRI
276.description: My lord, you bear no blame for their fate.

277.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002640_HIEN
277.description: If not blame then responsibility. They were prisoners and still I chose to fight, knowing they could be executed in retaliation.

278.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002650_HIEN
278.description: But now we have a chance to bring them home. If it means bargaining with a monster, so be it.

280.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002670_HIEN
280.description: Besides, I think he likes me. Which is more than some can say.

281.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002680_ASAHI
281.description: Can you truly remember nothing? Nothing at all?

283.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002700_ASAHI
283.description: Yes. We were good friends, you and I. In fact, I've brought you a gift.

284.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002710_ASAHI
284.description: I pray that one day soon, as you gaze into that mirror, you will remember the woman staring back at you.

286.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002721_YOTSUYU
286.description: Who are you...? Who are you...?

289.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04200_002730_IMPERIALDOCTOR
289.description: How are you feeling, my lord?
